---
title: display order
---

```{julia}
println("before")
display("first")
println("between")
display("second")
println("after")
```

```{julia}
println("computing")
display("shown")
@info "done"
1 + 1
```

```{julia}
#| warning: false
println("one")
@warn "hidden"
display("shown")
println("two")
```
